annotations.title: List what a lab practical asks

description: List the structures an anatomy and physiology lab practical asks, section by section (for example the bones, the muscles, the brain, the heart, blood vessels, the nervous system, A&P 1 or A&P 2), with links to practise each. Use it when a student asks what to study for a lab practical or wants a checklist of structures.

practical.description: The practical or course unit, e.g. 'muscles', 'appendicular skeleton', 'A&P 2'.
